notes: Welcome tour: the first time NC3-NEST or NC3-CONTROL starts on a machine it walks you round every button on the ribbon, in the order your ribbon actually has them, with the cell view and the alarm strip first in CONTROL. Run it again any time from Settings (General in NEST, Display in CONTROL). Only one copy of each app runs at a time: a second launch brings the running one to the front. Cutting windows now come from the cell geometry: each flange or underside cut positions the beam with that cut at the datum, the web is taken from there in windows of 800 mm, and the roller check no longer moves a window or pops up - anything out of reach is marked and reported in the status. Lead-ins at split joints and on whole rips are two separate switches. Bent channel and bent angle: the torch wraps the bend radius without twisting, holes and end cuts share one rotation, pop marks land on the right face with separate SI / KO / pop switches. Taper-flange channels and beams are modelled with the slope. NEST: convert rolled channel or angle to bent plate with a before-and-after view, in bulk; a nested part that changes length or section comes off its bar and asks to re-nest; pop marks drawn as in CONTROL; a SETTINGS tab holds Settings, Customers and DSTV+.
